drugs are bad. don't fucking do them.

Press {0} to Walter White.

Beer
A 21+ beverage that can get you to do bad things, but feel pretty energized.
Ingredients: Water, barley, hops, yeast.

Root Beer
A super fizzy drink that'll leave you spinning but keep your stamina up.
Ingredients: Carbonated water, sugar, natural flavors, vanilla.

Blunt
The essential MLG prop for that pro-gamer chill session.
Wrapped in fancy leaves for ultimate 360-no-scope vibes.

Mountain Dew
The iconic gamer fuel that boosts your 420% MLG stats while you pwn noobs.
Ingredients: Carbonated water, high fructose corn syrup, orange juice, caffeine.

Ecstasy
A tiny pill that can make you feel on top of the world!
though the view isn't always pretty.

Glitchy's Own Lollipop
A zesty lime candy shaped like someones head.
Ingredients: 3 Green, 12% Lime Flavoring, 32% Corruption.

Cocaine
A suspicious white powder that helps you think like crazy.
Worth it? Absolutely.

Banana Split
A decadent ice cream treat loaded with enough sugar to send your heart racing.
Ingredients: Ice cream, bananas, chocolate syrup, whipped cream, cherries.

LSD
A party favorite that makes you feel invincible
if being on a trippy rollercoaster is your thing.

Crazy Cane
A sweet minty cane that grants invincibility at the cost of temporary insanity.
Ingredients: Peppermint, sugar, food coloring.

Meth
A dangerously addictive crystal that makes you feel like a 'genius' in the worst way.
Ingredients: Pseudoephedrine, red phosphorus, regret.

Chocolate Ice Cream
A creamy, chocolatey indulgence perfect for a sugar rush.
Ingredients: Milk, cocoa, sugar, cream.

Heroin
Not recommended for personal use
best shared with people who won't leave you alone.

Chamomile Tea
A gentle brew to calm your friends in distress. One sip can ease the mind.
Ingredients: Chamomile flowers, water, honey.

Cigarette
A smoky stick for sneaky cover, but watch out
your lungs WON'T thank you.

Pixie Stick
A sweet candy powder in a straw that loves to get everywhere.
Ingredients: Powdered sugar, artificial flavoring.

Old Fashioned BSODA
Pop open a can of fizzy havoc to spray away anyone blocking your path.
Ingredients: Blue, high fructose corn syrup, electricity, 2% or less of water, blue 2, cocaine.

Old Fashioned BSODA
A classic carbonated can to blast away your troubles.
Ingredients: Blue, high fructose corn syrup, electricity, 2% or less of water, blue 2, hyperactive sugar.

Ketamine
Time-bending liquid for those who crave lightspeed frenzy, just don't overdose...

Broken Clock
A busted clock that can't freeze time
but sure knows how to slow it down.

Wine
A sophisticated adult drink that'll send you spinning at any proper soirée.
Ingredients: Grapes, yeast, water.

Grape Juice
A fancy, fizzy drink that everyone can enjoy, though it can leave you a little dizzy.
Ingredients: Grapes, sugar, and a tiny hint of citrus.

Edible
A gummy snack that packs a mellow punch—use wisely.
Ingredients: Gelatin, sugar, THC extract, artificial flavors.

Fruit Gummy
A fun, fruity chew that's safe for all ages.
Ingredients: Gelatin, sugar, fruit juice, natural flavors.

Magic Mushrooms
Brownish-gray mushrooms that can cause insane hallucinations
similar to what Brian Griffin from Family Guy did.
